FAQ.title: Most Questions We Have Answers
FAQ.subtitle: Have questions about insurance billing, emergency appointments, or first visits? Find quick answers below.
FAQ.q1: Do you offer direct electronic billing to insurance providers?
FAQ.a1: Yes! We bill directly to major Canadian insurance providers including Sun Life, Manulife, Canada Life, Desjardins, and Blue Cross so you pay zero upfront out-of-pocket costs for covered treatments.
FAQ.q2: Can I visit any branch if I am registered at one clinic?
FAQ.a2: Absolutely. Thanks to our 100% centralized EMR system, your X-rays, medical records, and treatment history are securely accessible by licensed staff across all 10+ Canadian locations.
FAQ.q3: How do same-day emergency appointments work?
FAQ.a3: We reserve daily emergency slots at every branch for severe toothaches, broken teeth, or facial trauma. Simply call 1-800-DENTAL-CA or book online for immediate care.
FAQ.q4: Are your fees compliant with provincial fee guides?
FAQ.a4: Yes, all our treatment fees follow official provincial dental association fee guides (Ontario ODA, BC BCDA, Alberta ADA) with zero hidden clinic markups.
FAQ.q5: What should I bring for my first dental visit?
FAQ.q5a: Please bring a valid photo ID, your dental insurance card/details, and any recent dental X-rays if available. You can also complete your digital intake forms online prior to arrival.
